representation_notes: The exact prepared lean_header is retained as a prefix; its category-1 dependencies have no provisional E ports in this source. All six H roots are retained; M results are used directly from Mathlib. The highest weight remains an integer; ell=Int.toNat lam is identified with it only using H003. Idx lam=Fin(ell+1) indexes 0 through ell; natural subtraction occurs only in source natural indices, while eigenvalue subtraction is performed in ℂ after casting (equivalently the source integer expression). Endomorphism multiplication is composition with the rightmost map acting first. ev is defined at every natural index so guarded off-range expressions need no fabricated Fin element. M is a genuine integer submodule of the original complex V and is not the minimal lattice. Its paired basis in H006 has size ell+1; under H003 and the finite dimension H004 this is equivalent to the original unrestricted paired-basis condition by reindexing. H004 explicitly retains finite dimension and complex irreducibility, expressed as the invariant-subspace dichotomy for the generators; H005 retains all highest-weight and Chevalley equations. latticeEnd restricts when preservation holds and defaults to zero otherwise, making the object definition total without assuming preservation: T002 must prove preservation and agreement with each original operator. TensorLeft=K⊗ℤM uses the native left-factor K-action. TensorRight=M⊗ℤK keeps the original abelian group and receives its K-action via the additive balanced swap; T011 proves that this is precisely scalar multiplication on the K factor and that induced lattice maps have the prescribed pure-tensor action. Thus the two actual representations are connected by a checked conversion, then T004 transports the matrix units and dimension to the original order. Nontrivial is nonzeroness; bottom/top are zero/whole subspaces. Background notes remain node-local references, never new assumptions. The two universes uK/uV are public object universes; N005 additionally uses its own named universes and T006 records its application at K and TensorRight K M.

(∀ (i j : Idx lam) (m : M), (integralMatrix lam x y) i j (m : V) ∈ M ∧ ((fun i j : Idx lam => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) i j m : V) = (integralMatrix lam x y) i j (m : V)) ∧
(∀ i j k l : Idx lam, (fun i j : Idx lam => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) i j * (fun i j : Idx lam => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) k l = if j = k then (coeff lam j : ℤ) • (fun i j : Idx lam => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) i l else 0) ∧
(∑ i : Idx lam, (coeffOmit lam i : ℤ) • (fun i j : Idx lam => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) i i) = (coeffProd lam : ℤ) • (1 : Module.End ℤ M) ∧
(∀ i : Idx lam, coeffProd lam = coeff lam i * coeffOmit lam i) ∧
(∀ r : ℕ, (r.factorial : ℤ) • (fun r : ℕ => latticeEnd M (dividedPower x r)) r = (latticeEnd M x) ^ r ∧ (r.factorial : ℤ) • (fun r : ℕ => latticeEnd M (dividedPower y r)) r = (latticeEnd M y) ^ r) ∧
(∀ (r : ℕ) (m : M), ((fun r : ℕ => latticeEnd M (dividedPower x r)) r m : V) = dividedPower x r (m : V) ∧ ((fun r : ℕ => latticeEnd M (dividedPower y r)) r m : V) = dividedPower y r (m : V)) ∧
(∀ m : M, x (m : V) ∈ M ∧ y (m : V) ∈ M ∧ h (m : V) ∈ M ∧
 ((latticeEnd M x) m : V) = x (m : V) ∧ ((latticeEnd M y) m : V) = y (m : V) ∧ ((latticeEnd M h) m : V) = h (m : V)) ∧
(latticeEnd M h) = (latticeEnd M x) * (latticeEnd M y) - (latticeEnd M y) * (latticeEnd M x) ∧
(∀ i j : Idx lam, (fun i j : Idx lam => latticeEnd M (integralMatrix lam x y i j)) i j = (fun r : ℕ => latticeEnd M (dividedPower x r)) (ell lam-i.val) * (fun r : ℕ => latticeEnd M (dividedPower y r)) (ell lam) * (fun r : ℕ => latticeEnd M (dividedPower x r)) (ell lam) * (fun r : ℕ => latticeEnd M (dividedPower y r)) (ell lam-j.val))
